o.text: Present participle compound of göy (“sky”) + dəl- (“to pierce, make a hole”). Calque of Russian небоскрёб (neboskrjób). Coined by Azerbaijani writer Rəsul Rza.
Borrowed from Russian а́рфа (árfa), ultimately from German Harfe.
From Proto-Turkic *sag-. Cognate with Chuvash су (su).
From Proto-Turkic *südre- (“to pull, tug”). Cognate with Turkish sürümek.
